questions.text: Would you like to tell me about the loss you're carrying? I'm here to listen.
questions.verse_text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

questions.text: What do you miss most about the person or thing you've lost?
questions.verse_text: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance.
follow_up_hints: There is a time for this

questions.text: Have you given yourself permission to grieve fully, or do you feel pressure to 'move on'?
How has this loss affected your relationship with God?
questions.verse_text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

questions.text: Do you sometimes feel angry at God for allowing this loss?
questions.verse_text: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring? O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

questions.text: What helps you feel closest to the person you've lost?
questions.verse_text: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

questions.text: Can you imagine a day when the grief feels lighter, not gone, but bearable?
questions.verse_text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

questions.text: Is there something you never got to say? Would you like to say it now?
questions.verse_text: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us.

questions.text: How can I, through Scripture, bring comfort to you today?
questions.verse_text: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort; Who comforteth us in all our tribulation.

questions.text: What is one small thing that has brought you a moment of peace lately?
questions.verse_text: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
